response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished full-stack developer with 20 years of experience and strong architectural thinking, he is fundamentally misaligned with this C++ industrial automation security role. His C++ experience is limited to 6 months at National Instruments (2014-2015), far below the required 8-12 years. More critically, the resume shows no evidence of industrial cybersecurity expertise, IEC 62443 standards, secure coding practices, IoT development, or industrial automation background—all core to this position. His recent career has focused on web/backend technologies (Node.js, TypeScript, React) rather than embedded systems, high-performance C++, or secure engineering practices.
strengths: Extensive 20-year career with multiple senior/staff roles demonstrating strong architectural thinking and design pattern expertise
Proven mentoring and teaching abilities through workshops, code katas, and leadership roles across organizations
Experience with event-driven architectures, microservices infrastructure, and low-latency system optimization
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015); entire recent career focused on Node.js, TypeScript, and web technologies
No demonstrated expertise in industrial cybersecurity, IEC 62443 standards, or Secure Development Lifecycle practices required for compliance
No IoT, industrial automation, embedded systems, or manufacturing background; career entirely in web and SaaS platforms

key_factors.factor: Missing security and industrial domain knowledge
